def load():

    t=open(d+'/../../sessions/'+os.path.basename(d)+'.jsonl').read().replace('\\n','\n'); G={}

        rows=[r.split() for r in t[m.end():].split('\n')[:h]]
        if k not in G and all(len(r)==w and all(x.isdigit() for x in r) for r in rows):
            G[k]=[[int(x) for x in r] for r in rows]

def load():

from collections import Counter
def comps(cells,bg,H,W,structure=((-1,-1),(-1,0),(-1,1),(0,-1),(0,0),(0,1),(1,-1),(1,0),(1,1))):
    seen=set(); res=[]
    for y,x in cells:
        if (y,x) in seen: continue
        stack=[(y,x)]; group=[]
        while stack:
            y,x=stack.pop()
            if (y,x) in seen or grid[y][x]==bg: continue
            seen.add((y,x)); group.append((y,x))
            for dy,dx in structure:
                ny,nx=y+dy,x+dx
                if 0<=ny<H and 0<=nx<W and (ny,nx) not in seen and grid[ny][nx]!=bg:
                    stack.append((ny,nx))
        res.append(group)
    return res
